data.longcaption: Good for starting a conversation and seeing which chat tools are available.
data.markdowncontent: Greets the user and shows a menu of the EME Server scenarios to choose from.

data.longcaption: Good for finding media by simply describing what you are looking for.
data.markdowncontent: Helps customers find media by parsing natural language requests, searching the catalog, and presenting matching assets and records.

data.longcaption: Good for asking the assistant to run a background job, like tagging or creating content, for you.
data.markdowncontent: Analyzes customer requests and conversation context to match appropriate automation skills and schedule background AI agent jobs on the customer's behalf.

data.longcaption: Good for learning a topic interactively, with questions, feedback and progress tracking.
data.markdowncontent: Powers an adaptive interactive tutoring session that guides learners step-by-step through educational material, evaluates responses, awards cognitive confidence scores, tracks mastery progress, and answers learner questions.

data.longcaption: Good for getting quick answers about the files and records in your library.
data.markdowncontent: Provides interactive question-and-answer capabilities over catalog assets and entities, generating contextual suggestion prompts and delivering AI answers retrieved via semantic vector search.
